subject: Learning Methods
title: Ritual and Routine
description: A fast breakdown of Ritual and Routine for builders.

hook.text: Beethoven counted exactly 60 coffee beans each morning before composing. The ritual signaled his brain to focus.

buildup.text: Pre-work rituals reduce startup friction. They serve as a cue that transitions your brain into concentration mode.

discovery.text: The ritual itself doesn't matter. What matters is consistency. The same cue every time builds an automatic response.

twist.text: Without a ritual, you waste 10 to 15 minutes warming up each session. A ritual collapses that startup time.

climax.text: Choose a simple ritual: make tea, close the door, open one document. Do it every time you begin deep work.

punchline.text: Same ritual. Every time. Focus becomes automatic.

quiz.question: How do pre-work rituals improve focus?
options: They provide physical energy for the session
They serve as a consistent cue that transitions the brain into focus mode
They eliminate the need for breaks
